text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I gave it everything I had just now. 
...Yet I couldn't win.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And yet... ...And yet...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Rising to victory from the ashes of defeat 
is a classic trope, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: ......Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
Good luck next time too, big sis! I can't 
wait to see you win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yes! Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess keeps her head held high 
and pushes forward. No one can stand in my 
way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Twists and turns are what make a story 
worth telling. This simply wasn't the 
"time for victory" just yet.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
“But I'm the heroine of this story, and in 
the end, I will definitely—!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —I shall make this a happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Hang in there, Princess! Don't lose 
next time!!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Princess, go, go, fight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in defeat, Kawakami Princess's 
determination to look forward rallied 
cheers from the audience.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though there isn't just one 
protagonist in a race. Every single person 
here is one too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while letting Kawakami Princess 
rest in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, thank you for your hard work 
today. I'm with "Umamusume Racing for 
Everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you the one who made that special 
video by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Smashing through every door and wall in 
her way! The princess enters the frayyy!!" 
...part!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! And so, I have a favor to 
ask...

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
After another amazing performance today, 
we'd love to ask Kawakami Princess to 
collaborate with our show!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
A collab, or rather, a special feature. 
We'd love to broadcast you live talking 
passionately about your next goal!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...The next goal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'd like to set our next goal as 
the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"The final battle of the Tiara route. 
Having lost the Yushun Himba, I have no 
intention of surrendering the final tiara 
to anyone."
choice_data_list: Understood, the Shuka Sho it is.
Understood, the Shuka Sho it is.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, overcoming defeat on the path to 
victory! Now is the time to show some 
sheer grit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Kawakami Princess spoke with such 
burning passion, the TV staff member gave 
her a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next goal is the 'Shuka Sho'.
